## Summary

Describe the user-visible or package-level change and why it belongs in dsh-notebook.

## Verification

List the exact commands or manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior or the change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Public API, package README, and bilingual documentation are updated when applicable.
- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes for release-facing changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private notebooks, generated environments, or local paths are committed.
